fields.title: 1. T1 — Expected vs Actual Date
fields.md:
- **Expected**: 2026-11-16 (US Eastern; statutory deadline 11-14 Saturday → next business day, formula — state.triggers_next_12m T1).
- **Actual**: SEC posting 2026-11-16 (US), cover signature date 2026-11-16 — the time this probe confirmed it was KST 2026-11-17 (sources: [EDGAR 13F list](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001067983&type=13F-HR&dateb=&owner=include&count=10) · [cover page](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/xslForm13F_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
- **Verdict**: Correct by US date, and confirmed one day later in KST — the 'US filing date + 1 day (KST confirmation date)' rule created in the previous edition was reproduced as is (source: section 1 of the [2026-11-16 edition](2026-11-16-event.md)). Rule kept; T3 expected date 2027-02-17 kept.
- Cover page entries: 14 other included managers · 89 information table rows · not an amendment (original report) (source: [cover page](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/xslForm13F_X02/primary_doc.xml)). No confidential-treatment request notation was found on the cover page — whether any positions outside the 13F will be disclosed later is unknown (judgment).
